text: dsh-compound-memory 为 DSH 接入 compound-memory：通过宿主 MCP 客户端启动记忆服务，挂载随包技能，并在每会话首次合格步骤注入使用提醒。提醒 agent 先搜索、采纳后反馈；工具支持记忆搜索、读取、写入、关联和反馈。适合希望在会话间复用共享记忆的 DSH 用户。运行需有 uvx，可配置记忆目录和宿主标识。

dsh-compound-memory connects a memory service to DSH using its MCP client, mounts a bundled skill, and adds a once-per-session usage reminder. It guides agents to search memory and give feedback after using results. The service supports search, get, write, link, and feedback. Requires uvx.
想让 DSH 在不同会话之间记住稳定的项目事实。
有没有办法在 DSH 里搜索并复用之前保存的记忆？
希望 agent 用到一条记忆后能给它反馈。
让 DSH 每个会话开始时提醒我先查共享记忆。
I want my DSH agents to reuse shared memories across sessions.
Can DSH remind an agent to search memory before a substantial task?
dsh-compound-memory 的功能「共享记忆服务接入」：配置 stdio MCP 服务，通过 uvx 启动 compound-memory-server，并在 DSH 中提供记忆服务的工具。
dsh-compound-memory 的功能「会话使用提醒」：在首次符合条件的 agent/pre-step enter 后追加一条 user 消息，提醒先搜索记忆并在采纳后反馈；同一 agent 后续步骤不重复注入。
dsh-compound-memory 的功能「随包技能挂载」：配置宿主的 filesystem skill provider，将已安装包内的 skills 目录作为 compound-memory 技能根挂载。
如何让 DSH 自动加载随插件提供的记忆使用指南？
I need a shared memory service available to my DSH sessions.
dsh-compound-memory 通过 uvx 启动 PyPI 上的 compound-memory-server；运行环境需提供 uvx，首次启动需能获取该服务包。

dsh-compound-memory README · dsh-compound-memory：DeepSeek Harness bundle that launches the existing [compound-memory](https://pypi.org/project/compound-memory/) MCP server (`uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory-server`), mounts the bundled `skills/compound-memory` skill, and injects a short once-per-session usage reminder. It does not reimplement memory, it does not add a sixth MCP tool, and the server still has no LLM ([ADR-0001](https://github.com/chinwe/compound-memory)). This wrapper adds none. There are no install, lifecycle, or `postinstall` scripts.

dsh-compound-memory README · dsh-compound-memory：`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`. That file inserts three rows: the in-box [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md) row (`mcp-compound-memory`), this package's own plugin (`compound-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`), and an in-box [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md) row (`compound-memory-skill`) whose only root is this package's `skills/`. Do not install that client yourself: DSH 0.2 already ships it, and a separately installed 0.1 client will not match ([discussion #8202](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8202)). This package declares no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies. The rules module does not import `@deepseek-ai/cordis` or the MCP client: Cordis calls `apply(ctx)`, and the [publish guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish) says to pin a peer only when the plugin must share that package's instance. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.0-rc

dsh-compound-memory README · dsh-compound-memory：| MCP tool | Name inside DSH |
|---|---|
| `memory_search` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_search` |
| `memory_get` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_get` |
| `memory_write` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_write` |
| `memory_link` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_link` |
| `memory_feedback` | `mcp__compound-memory__memory_feedback` |

`memory_search` returns an object whose `hits` field is an array.

dsh-compound-memory README · Install：Requires the [`dsh`](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/) CLI and `uv` / `uvx` on the `PATH` of the process that starts `dsh`. The first `uvx` run needs network access to fetch `compound-memory` from PyPI. `uv` supplies the tool's Python; a system Python is not required.

Package version 0.1.8, published on npm as [`dsh-compound-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compound-memory
```

From GitHub:

dsh-compound-memory README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chinwe/dsh-compound-memory
```

From a checkout of this repository (the plugin root, not a subdirectory):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-compound-memory
```

Git install does not need `allowBuilds`: the package has no `prepare` script. Restart `dsh`. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should show a `# == dsh-compound-memory` layer and the `mcp-compound-memory`, `compound-memory-rules`, and `compound-memory-skill` rows.

dsh-compound-memory README · Install：If the store does not exist yet:

```bash
uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory init
```

dsh-compound-memory README · Environment：Set these on the process that launches `dsh`. The patch reads them with `!!js` when config loads. Unset or blank uses the default. Nothing here is a secret. The stdio child starts from a scrubbed parent environment; configured `env` is merged on top.

| Variable | Default when unset or blank |
|---|---|
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` | `agent-dsh` |
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT` | `$HOME/.agents/memory` (optional; the Python server expands a leading `$HOME` or `~`) |

dsh-compound-memory README · Environment：`agent-dsh` is this host's stable id. Set `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` before starting `dsh` when this process should be a different host. A later patch layer replaces the whole `config`. To point `command` at an absolute `uvx`, restate the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (same fields: `serverName`, `transport`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `failOnStartupError`).

dsh-compound-memory README · Usage reminder：`compound-memory-rules` listens on `agent/pre-step` with `{ prepend: true }`. On the first eligible `enter` of a live agent (the decision is `enter` and the step signal is not aborted) it appends one user-role message. Later steps of that agent do not append it again. A new agent object whose session log already contains the reminder (resume, or this process restarted) does not get a second copy. The listener does not read the memory store and does not call a model (ADR-0001).

dsh-compound-memory README · Usage reminder：The message text is `RULES` in [`index.js`](index.js) (356 characters, under the 400-character Claude SessionStart budget). It states:

- `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` defaults to `agent-dsh` (overridable); pass that same id as `source` and `agent`
- `memory_search` before non-trivial work; `memory_feedback` after an adopted hit compounds the store
- in a repo, prefer project-scoped memories
- five MCP tools only, named `mcp__compound-memory__memory_*`; this package does not reimplement them

dsh-compound-memory README · Usage reminder：The source is `{ kind: 'plugin:dsh-compound-memory', form: 'instructions' }`, and the message has a fresh `id`. Session format v4 rejects the retired `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin }` wrapper and fails the whole turn ([discussion #8432](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8432)). `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` is the producer-owned kind the v3→v4 rewriter would derive for this package. A static `systemPrompt.section` was not required: pre-step accepts the message, and injecting once keeps it out of every later step.

dsh-compound-memory README · Disable the reminder：Stop only the reminder. In the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) or the home patch (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`), add:

```yaml
- id: compound-memory-rules
  disabled: true
```

dsh-compound-memory README · Disable the reminder：A later layer addresses the row by id. `disabled: true` stops that loader entry. `mcp-compound-memory` is a different id and still launches `uvx`. `compound-memory-skill` is a different id and still mounts the bundled skill. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` removes all three rows.

dsh-compound-memory README · Verify：`dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows `mcp-compound-memory`, `compound-memory-rules`, and `compound-memory-skill` under `# == dsh-compound-memory`.

Start a new session and send one message. The transcript should contain one user-role reminder whose `source.kind` is `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` and whose text starts with `compound-memory:`. A later step in that same session should not add another copy. `node --test` in this repository checks the listener without booting DSH.

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：Usage for the five tools is [`skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md`](skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md). The injected reminder is the short hard rules. The skill is the long-form source. On a non-trivial task, call `memory_search` first. After a hit is actually used, call `memory_feedback` with `agent` set to `agent-dsh` (or whatever `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` is). Write only stable facts.

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：`compound-memory-skill` mounts that directory. The row names the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` provider, with `providerName: compound-memory` and `includeDefaultRoots: false`, so this provider does not scan project or user skill roots. `bundledSkillDir` is a `!!js` expression: join `skills` onto the directory of `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-compound-memory/package.json')`. `baseUrl` is the DSH profile, so the path is the installed package and not the process cwd. `exports` includes `./package.json` because a map that only names `"."` makes that resolve throw `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`. `exports["."]` is still `./index.js`.

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：After install or upgrade, restart `dsh`. `/compound-memory` loads the bundled skill. A manual copy or symlink is no longer required. One already on a skill root can stay. The registry keeps a single `compound-memory` name: within one layer the lower rank wins, and project or user roots (ranks 100–500) outrank this bundled root (rank 600) ([skills subsystem](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/skills.md)). The reminder does not load the skill, and the skill does not replace the reminder.

dsh-compound-memory README · 中文：这是 DeepSeek Harness 的 bundle，用 `uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory-server` 拉起 PyPI 上已有的 [compound-memory](https://pypi.org/project/compound-memory/) MCP server，挂载随包的 `skills/compound-memory` 技能，并在每个会话第一次进入模型步骤时注入一段短的使用提醒。不在 JS 里重写记忆，不增加第 6 个 MCP tool。server 内没有 LLM（[ADR-0001](https://github.com/chinwe/compound-memory)），这个 wrapper 也不加。没有 install、lifecycle 或 `postinstall` 脚本。

dsh-compound-memory README · 中文：根上的 `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`，插入三行：宿主自带的 [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md)（`mcp-compound-memory`），本包自己的插件（`compound-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`），以及宿主自带的 [`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md)（`compound-memory-skill`），它的唯一根是本包的 `skills/`。不要单独安装这个 client：DSH 0.2 已经带了匹配版本，另装 0.1 会对不上（[讨论 #8202](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8202)）。因此本包不声明任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖。规则模块不 import `@deepseek-ai/cordis`，也不 import MCP client：Cordis 调用 `apply(ctx)`；[发布指南](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish) 只要求在必须和宿主共享同一实例时才 pin peer。`engines.dsh` 为 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，当前 0.2 预发布能匹配，0.3 预发布不能（[发布指南](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish)、[市场索引格式](https://www.dsh-remote.com/notes/implemented/feature/2026-10-02-plugin-market-index-format)）。
dsh-compound-memory README · 中文：DSH 里的工具名是 `mcp__compound-memory__memory_search`、`memory_get`、`memory_write`、`memory_link`、`memory_feedback`（前缀相同）。`memory_search` 的返回体含 `hits` 数组。

dsh-compound-memory README · 安装：需要 [`dsh`](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/) CLI，以及启动 `dsh` 的那个进程的 `PATH` 上有 `uv` / `uvx`。第一次 `uvx` 要从 PyPI 拉 `compound-memory`，需要网络。Python 由 `uv` 自己准备，不要求系统里先装 Python。

包版本 0.1.8，npm 包名为 [`dsh-compound-memory`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compound-memory)：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compound-memory
```

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chinwe/dsh-compound-memory
```

用本仓库检出（插件根就是仓库根，不要指子目录）：

dsh-compound-memory README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-compound-memory
```

Git 安装不需要 `allowBuilds`：没有 `prepare` 脚本。装完重启 `dsh`。`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 应出现 `# == dsh-compound-memory` 层，以及 `mcp-compound-memory`、`compound-memory-rules`、`compound-memory-skill` 三行。

记忆库还不存在时先初始化：

```bash
uvx --from compound-memory compound-memory init
```

dsh-compound-memory README · 环境变量：写在启动 `dsh` 的环境里。patch 在加载配置时用 `!!js` 读取；未设置或空白才用默认值。这里没有密钥。stdio 子进程从清洗过的父环境启动，配置里的 `env` 再叠上去。

| 变量 | 未设置或空白时的默认值 |
|---|---|
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` | `agent-dsh` |
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT` | `$HOME/.agents/memory`（可选；Python server 会展开开头的 `$HOME` 或 `~`） |

dsh-compound-memory README · 环境变量：`agent-dsh` 是这个宿主的稳定 id。这个进程要当成别的宿主时，启动 `dsh` 之前设置 `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID`。后一层 patch 会整行替换 `config`。要把 `command` 改成 `uvx` 的绝对路径，就在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 重写整行（字段仍是 `serverName`、`transport`、`command`、`args`、`env`、`failOnStartupError`）。

dsh-compound-memory README · 使用提醒：`compound-memory-rules` 以 `{ prepend: true }` 听 `agent/pre-step`。某个 agent 第一次合格的 `enter`（决定是 `enter`，且该步的 signal 未 abort）追加一条 user 消息。这个 agent 之后的步骤不再追加。新的 agent 对象如果会话日志里已经有这条提醒（resume，或进程重启后），不会再追加第二条。监听器不读记忆库，也不调用模型（ADR-0001）。

dsh-compound-memory README · 使用提醒：正文是 [`index.js`](index.js) 里的 `RULES`（356 字符，短于 Claude SessionStart 的 400 字符上限）。内容是：`COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` 默认 `agent-dsh`（可覆盖），`source` 和 `agent` 传同一个 id；非琐碎工作前 `memory_search`；采纳命中后 `memory_feedback` 才让记忆库复利；在仓库里优先写项目作用域记忆；只有五个 MCP 工具，DSH 里的名字是 `mcp__compound-memory__memory_*`；本包不重写它们。

dsh-compound-memory README · 使用提醒：source 是 `{ kind: 'plugin:dsh-compound-memory', form: 'instructions' }`，并带新的 `id`。会话格式 v4 拒绝旧的 `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin }`，整轮会失败（[讨论 #8432](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8432)）。`plugin:dsh-compound-memory` 是 v3→v4 重写器会给这个包推导出的产方 kind。不需要改成静态 `systemPrompt.section`：pre-step 能写入这条消息，每会话一次也不会在后续步骤里重复。

dsh-compound-memory README · 只关闭提醒：MCP server 继续跑，只停提醒。在 profile 的 patch（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）或家目录 patch（`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- id: compound-memory-rules
  disabled: true
```

后一层按 id 定位这一行。`disabled: true` 停掉这个 loader 条目。`mcp-compound-memory` 是另一个 id，仍会拉起 `uvx`。`compound-memory-skill` 也是另一个 id，仍会挂载随包技能。`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` 会三行一起去掉。

dsh-compound-memory README · 核对：`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 在 `# == dsh-compound-memory` 下应看到 `mcp-compound-memory`、`compound-memory-rules` 和 `compound-memory-skill`。

开一个新会话发一条消息。记录里应有一条 user 提醒，`source.kind` 为 `plugin:dsh-compound-memory`，正文以 `compound-memory:` 开头。同一会话的后续步骤不应再追加一条。本仓库的 `node --test` 不启动 DSH，只检查这个监听器。

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：五个工具怎么用见 [`skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md`](skills/compound-memory/SKILL.md)。注入的是短硬规则；skill 是完整用法。非琐碎任务先 `memory_search`。实际采纳命中后，用 `agent` `agent-dsh`（或当前的 `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID`）调 `memory_feedback`。只写稳定事实。

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：`compound-memory-skill` 挂载这个目录。这一行是宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`，`providerName` 为 `compound-memory`，`includeDefaultRoots: false`，因此这个 provider 不扫描项目或用户技能根。`bundledSkillDir` 是一段 `!!js`：对 `createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-compound-memory/package.json')` 所在目录再拼上 `skills`。`baseUrl` 是 DSH profile，所以路径指向已安装的包，而不是启动进程时的 cwd。`exports` 增加了 `./package.json`；如果映射里只有 `"."`，这次 resolve 会抛 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`。`exports["."]` 仍是 `./index.js`。

dsh-compound-memory README · Skill：安装或升级后重启 `dsh`，`/compound-memory` 就会加载随包技能。不再需要手动复制或软链。已经放在某个技能根上的副本可以留着。注册表里同名 `compound-memory` 只保留一份：同一层里 rank 更小的胜出，项目或用户根（rank 100–500）高于这个随包根（rank 600）（[skills 子系统](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/skills.md)）。提醒不会加载技能，技能也不代替提醒。
